disposition: Six world-history foundation articles were added after checkpoint 387; 351 substantive rewrites/additions and 42 retained teaching flows in total. The batch follows survival, settlement, urban coordination, learning institutions, mobile pastoral societies and digital information order without presenting history as one inevitable ladder.

validation.individual: Each addition has ten teach-system sections, three responsive visualizations, three owned concepts, exact 6+4 exercises, two source-reading contracts and a bounded everyday numeric case.
validation.numeric: The cases trace food 100 becoming 85 after drought and network support, harvest allocation and a poor-harvest remainder of 55, a grain ledger with a missing 10, a learning institution's resource ledger, a herd changing from 100 to 90, and an exposure funnel from 100 published items to 5 viewed items. Illustrative values are marked as assumptions.
